topic: Sankashti par Mushak ka vrat aur chaand ka intezaar
summary: Kailash Parivar mini: Sankashti ke vrat mein Mushak chaand ka intezaar karta hai; Ganesh ji dhairya sikhate hain, chaand nikalte hi pehla laddoo
moral: Vrat ka phal dhairya mein hai
title: Chaand ka intezaar
source: Parampara: Sankashti Chaturthi par chandrodaya ke baad, Chandra ko arghya dekar vrat kholte hain; Ganesh ji aur Chandra ki katha parampara mein kahi jaati hai. Mushak ka vrat aur laddoo is episode ki kalpana hai.

facts.claim: Sankashti Chaturthi ka vrat din bhar rakha jaata hai aur raat ko chandrodaya ke baad Chandra ko arghya dekar kholte hain
Parampara mein Ganesh ji aur Chandra ki katha kahi jaati hai (Chandra ne Ganesh ji ka roop dekhkar hansi udayi, to Ganesh ji ne shraap diya)

scenes.prompt: A quiet evening on snowy Mount Kailash, little Bal Ganesh sits beside a small oil lamp and a leaf plate of laddoos, his cute little mouse Mushak sits next to him looking up at a cloudy darkening sky with a hungry hopeful face, Mata Parvati stands behind them with a puja thali, warm lamp light, medium wide shot
scenes.animate: the oil lamp flickers softly and Mushak tilts his head up to look at the sky

lines.tts: प्रभु, चाँद कब निकलेगा? भूख से पेट गुड़गुड़ा रहा है!
lines.sub: Prabhu, chaand kab niklega? Bhookh se pet gudguda raha hai!

lines.tts: मूषक, आज तुमने भी संकष्टी का व्रत रखा है, है ना?
lines.sub: Mushak, aaj tumne bhi Sankashti ka vrat rakha hai, hai na?

lines.tts: जी प्रभु! पर चाँद तो बादलों में छुप गया… मैं थक गया।
lines.sub: Ji Prabhu! Par chaand to baadlon mein chhup gaya... main thak gaya.

scenes.prompt: Close view of little Bal Ganesh gently comforting his small mouse Mushak on a snowy rock, Mata Parvati smiles lovingly beside them, soft twilight with drifting clouds and a few stars, warm light, medium shot

lines.tts: बेटा मूषक, धैर्य रखो। गणेश, इसे वह कथा सुनाओ।
lines.sub: Beta Mushak, dhairya rakho. Ganesh, ise woh katha sunao.

lines.tts: सुनो मूषक। कहते हैं, चाँद के दर्शन और अर्घ्य के बाद ही व्रत खुलता है।
lines.sub: Suno Mushak. Kehte hain, chaand ke darshan aur arghya ke baad hi vrat khulta hai.

scenes.prompt: The clouds part and a bright full moon rises over snowy Mount Kailash, little Bal Ganesh offers a small copper vessel of water in arghya with folded hands, his happy mouse Mushak jumps with joy beside him, a laddoo on a leaf plate in front, Mata Parvati smiles in the background, silver moonlight and warm lamp glow, wide shot
scenes.animate: the clouds slowly part to reveal the glowing moon and Mushak hops happily beside the laddoo

lines.tts: धैर्य का फल मीठा होता है, मूषक। देखो… चाँद निकल आया!
lines.sub: Dhairya ka phal meetha hota hai, Mushak. Dekho... chaand nikal aaya!

lines.tts: जय गजानन! चाँद आ गया, चाँद आ गया!
lines.sub: Jai Gajanan! Chaand aa gaya, chaand aa gaya!

endcard.tts: व्रत का फल धैर्य में है। अच्छा लगे तो लाइक और सब्सक्राइब करें।
endcard.sub: Vrat ka phal dhairya mein hai. Achha lage to Like aur Subscribe karein.
